fields.name: name
fields.meaning: Display name of the forum.

fields.name: intro
fields.meaning: Description text (intro) of the forum.

fields.name: introformat
fields.meaning: Text format of the intro.

fields.name: type
fields.meaning: Forum type. "news" and "social" cannot be chosen through this catalog - they only exist on automatically created course/site forums.

fields.name: duedate
fields.meaning: Unix timestamp: due date, informational only (not a cut-off for posts). Creates a calendar entry (see side effects).

fields.name: cutoffdate
fields.meaning: Unix timestamp: from here on Moodle accepts no more forum posts. 0 = no cut-off.

fields.name: assessed
fields.meaning: Aggregation type for ratings (e.g. average, sum, no rating).

value_range.source: rating/lib.php (class rating_manager, method get_aggregate_types()); course/moodleform_mod.php:686,719 (add_rating_settings()); column mod/forum/db/install.xml (forum.assessed)

fields.name: scale
fields.meaning: Rating scale: positive = maximum points, negative = ID of a custom scale. Only effective when assessed != 0.

value_range.source: course/moodleform_mod.php:743-746 (add_rating_settings(), modgrade element; scale value = grademax/scaleid); column mod/forum/db/install.xml (forum.scale)

fields.name: grade_forum
fields.meaning: Overall grade of the forum (independent of the post rating via "assessed"): positive = maximum points, negative = ID of a custom scale, 0 = no grading.

fields.name: grade_forum_notify
fields.meaning: Notify learners about new grades by default.

fields.name: maxbytes
fields.meaning: Maximum file size per attachment in bytes. The selectable values are a subset depending on course and server limits, not a fixed list.

fields.name: maxattachments
fields.meaning: Maximum number of attachments per post.

fields.name: displaywordcount
fields.meaning: Show word count per post.

fields.name: forcesubscribe
fields.meaning: Subscription mode. Value 2 (auto-subscription) immediately subscribes all potential course participants on creation or switching - see side effects.

fields.name: trackingtype
fields.meaning: Read tracking: off, optional (learners decide) or forced.

fields.name: rsstype
fields.meaning: RSS feed content: off, discussions or posts. Only selectable if RSS is enabled server-wide.

fields.name: rssarticles
fields.meaning: Number of entries in the RSS feed. Only effective when rsstype != 0.

fields.name: warnafter
fields.meaning: Show a warning from this number of posts within the block period. 0 = off. Only effective when blockperiod != 0.

fields.name: blockafter
fields.meaning: Block further posts from this number of posts within the block period. 0 = off. Only effective when blockperiod != 0.

fields.name: blockperiod
fields.meaning: Period in seconds over which warnafter/blockafter are counted. 0 = blocking disabled.

fields.name: completiondiscussions
fields.meaning: Number of started discussions from which the activity counts as completed. 0 = no condition.

fields.name: completionreplies
fields.meaning: Number of replies from which the activity counts as completed. 0 = no condition.

fields.name: completionposts
fields.meaning: Number of posts (discussions + replies combined) from which the activity counts as completed. 0 = no condition.

fields.name: lockdiscussionafter
fields.meaning: Period in seconds after which a discussion without a new reply is locked automatically. 0 = off. Not effective for type=single.

value_range.source: mod/forum/mod_form.php:164-178 (disabledIf type eq single); column mod/forum/db/install.xml (forum.lockdiscussionafter)

forcesubscribe.2: All course participants have been subscribed to this forum.

pseudofields.name: ratingtime
pseudofields.meaning: Checkbox: restrict the rating period. Only when set does Moodle take over "assesstimestart"/"assesstimefinish" - otherwise forum_update_instance() resets both to 0. Not a DB field.

combination_rules: "type"="single" cannot be combined with "groupmode"=SEPARATEGROUPS (mod/forum/mod_form.php: validation()); "groupmode" is in the shared block.
side_effects: "forcesubscribe"=2 (auto-subscription) immediately subscribes all potential course participants on creation or when switching to this value - from then on they receive emails about every new post (mod/forum/lib.php: forum_instance_created(), forum_update_instance()).
"duedate" creates or updates a calendar entry (mod/forum/locallib.php: forum_update_calendar()); "cutoffdate" does not.

cutoffdate.reason: After the cut-off date learners can no longer post unless the teacher moves the date.

lockdiscussionafter.reason: Inactive discussions get locked; only the teacher can unlock them.

blockafter.reason: Learners are blocked from posting once they reach the post threshold in the period.
